text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: The Hanshin Daishoten, a 3000m long-distance turf race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "It reminds me of the Kikuka-sho. Though the place and circumstances are different now."
choice_data_list: And you've grown so much yourself.
And you've grown so much yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Well, I won't let anyone say taking a loss here
means I've hit my ceiling.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Watch closely, Trainer.
Watch as I sink my teeth into victory.
